These products were recommended to me and my daughter by another one of my daughters.  I've been using them for over a month and couldn't be happier. Now I use both the Argon Oil shampoo AND conditioner and what a difference.  I don't loose my hair in the shower and I don't loose my hair on my brush when brushing.

claims.text: Many reviewers report their hair feels soft, shiny, and healthier after use.
Several reviewers say the product reduced their hair loss or left less hair when brushing.
Some reviewers report the opposite, saying it made their hair dry, frizzy, or caused hair loss.
A few reviewers mention buildup or weighing down of hair with continued use.
Some reviewers praise the scent, while others find it chemical or absent.

qa.q: Is this sulfate free and safe for color treated hair?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Will it help with dry or damaged hair?
qa.answer: Yes, reviews report it helps dry or damaged hair: one reviewer with very dry, bleached hair said it looks and feels much healthier [3], and another with short, dry, rough, coarse hair felt moisturized and hydrated after the first wash [4]. A reviewer with processed hair also said it leaves hair soft and shiny [5].

claims.text: A reviewer with very dry, bleached hair said the product made hair look and feel much healthier.
A reviewer with short, dry, rough, coarse hair felt moisturized and hydrated after the first wash.
A reviewer with processed hair said the product leaves hair soft and shiny.

qa.q: Is it gentle enough for curly hair?
qa.answer: Yes, one reviewer with coarse, curly hair (and their granddaughter) found it made hair soft and less dry and frizzy after the first use [2]. However, another reviewer with short, dry, rough, coarse hair noted the shampoo had a "crunchy feel" to it [1].

claims.text: A reviewer with coarse, curly hair reported soft, less dry and frizzy hair after the first use.
Another reviewer with coarse hair noted the shampoo had a crunchy feel.

qa.q: Does it have a strong smell?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on smell: some describe it as pleasant or good [1][4][6], while others say it had no smell [2] or a very chemical smell [3].

claims.text: The smell is described as pleasant or good.
One reviewer said it had no smell.
One reviewer said the smell is very chemical.

qa.q: Is the 8oz size worth the price?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on value: some call it overpriced for tiny bottles [1] or expensive for the product quality [4], while others say the shampoo is so concentrated it lasts forever [6] and one wishes for a bigger size than 8 oz [2].

claims.text: Some reviewers consider it overpriced for tiny bottles or expensive for the product quality.
Other reviewers say the shampoo is concentrated and lasts forever, and one wishes for a bigger size than 8 oz.
